title: Chapter 383 Defeating The Red Force
content:
Chapter 383 Defeating The Red Force

Wang Shuo ambushed twice as many people as the other side, and also had a team of generals.

It took only one stick of incense to wipe out all the people on the other side.

Wang Shuo was more relieved now.

The main force of the red side outside had at most 1,500 people, and they could beat them even without an ambush.

Wang Shuo immediately led all the troops and rushed towards the earth mother worm area.

It seemed that the red side must have discovered something extraordinary, so they only separated a part of the troops to rescue the base.

What else is more important than the base?

What made them willing to take such a risk?

Along the way, Wang Shuo saw countless earth mother worm corpses. This large-scale gathering, sweeping the Zerg, the speed and efficiency are far beyond the reach of dozens of people.

After advancing a distance, Wang Shuo saw the main force of the red side.

Wang Shuo also had to sigh that the other side's commander was really...

They were now attacking the ultimate boss of the earth mother worm with all their strength.

I saw a worm as big as a mountain, surrounded by hundreds of people.

That's right, the red team has less than 1,000 people. There are more than a dozen dark gold bosses around the ultimate Earth Mother Worm boss, who are very ferocious, and the corpses of humans are everywhere.

Wang Shuo did not lead the large army to rush directly, but secretly ambushed in the distance.

"It seems that I can pick up a big bargain."

Wang Shuo showed a victorious smile on his face. The opponent's move was too risky. They were caught by him. They could only blame their bad luck.

More than a dozen dark gold bosses were quickly killed under the siege of the red team's generals.

After Wang Shuo explored it, he found that this Earth Mother Worm King was a platinum boss.

It should be at the same level as the primary human generals.

But his combat power actually requires dozens of human generals to kill him.

This made Wang Shuo have a different understanding of the combat power of these bosses.

Even bosses of the same level have strong and weak combat power. As the emperor, this Earth Mother Worm is still acceptable.

At this time, hundreds of red fighters have begun to besiege the Earth Mother Insect Emperor.

Wang Shuo looked at the opportunity and felt that he could not wait any longer.

Taking advantage of the time when both sides were injured, he suddenly rushed out, so as to achieve the best effect.

"Kill!"

Wang Shuo's sudden rush scared the red team.

The commander of the red team was in a dilemma at this time. He had to deal with the Earth Mother Insect Emperor and the purple army.

Seeing the enemy personnel who were several times larger than himself, the red team fell into chaos.

Wang Shuo held a spear in his hand and rode on the back of the big yellow. Like a cannonball, he instantly popped out and rushed towards the enemy who was in chaos.

A junior general, Wang Shuo only needed two shots to solve one, completely crushing him like a rotten wood.

The red general who was responsible for attacking the Earth Mother Insect Emperor immediately gave up the Insect Emperor and turned to deal with the purple general.

But at this time, the strength of the two sides was very different. After a few moves, the other side was defeated.

Seeing that the situation was hopeless, the leader of the red team wanted to take the opportunity to escape.

Wang Shuo immediately shouted: "Zhang Ren, don't let the enemy leader escape."

Zhang Ren immediately turned around and chased after him with his team of warriors.

Wang Shuo looked at the furious Earth Mother Insect Emperor at this time and weighed whether to take over.

After thinking about it for a while, Wang Shuo made up his mind and did it!

The temptation of a platinum boss is undoubtedly huge!
